name: Moon Beauty Studios
niche: nail salon boutique / beauty studio (nails, lash, brows, facials)
address_raw: 6355 SW 8th St, Floor 3, Miami, FL 33144 (inside Sola Salon Studios, Westchester)
location_note: Private suite inside a shared salon-suites building (Sola Salon Studios Westchester), not a standalone storefront. No public exterior facade photo available; gallery and hero use real interior/service photos instead.
phone_source: pro.makeup business directory (https://pro.makeup/salon/united-states/west-miami/moon-beauty-studios-vz), corroborated by exact address match and exact staff names (Zarahy Carrera, Valentina Moreno) against the Booksy listing. NOT found on Booksy itself (Booksy telephone field was null) or on the Instagram profile (IG blocked automated fetch, see research_notes).
email_note: No public email found after deep search: Booksy payload (telephone/email fields), Instagram bio (blocked, see research_notes), Facebook (no dedicated page found for this business), pro.makeup directory listing. Outreach will be pending_manual via Instagram DM or phone.
has_own_site_check: Verified independently (in addition to the discovery-phase check): moonbeautystudios.com, moonbeautystudio.com, moonbeautystudiosmiami.com, moon-beauty-studios.com, moonbeautystudios.net and moonbeautystudios.co all fail DNS resolution (NXDOMAIN via python socket.gethostbyname). Booksy's own sameAs/website_candidates field is empty (no external domain listed). No domain found in the Instagram bio or Facebook.
reviews_count_source: Booksy JSON-LD aggregateRating (also independently confirmed by user's discovery research). Note: a third-party directory (pro.makeup) shows 36 reviews for the same business, likely a stale snapshot; Booksy is the primary source of truth and is used on the site.
staff_note: The 'V&Z' in some listings (e.g. pro.makeup) stands for these two names. Reviews repeatedly name both as the specialists performing services.
language_note: Reviews and menu show a genuine bilingual (Spanish/English) clientele typical of Westchester, Miami. Decided Spanish as the default site language based on: (1) several full-Spanish verbatim reviews (Genesis, and others), (2) the business's own menu on Booksy uses native Spanish service names not translated to English (e.g. 'Quiropedia Maintenance', 'Linea del Ombligo', 'Axilas', 'Bozo', 'Nasal'), indicating Spanish is used internally, not just by some customers, (3) the neighborhood (Westchester, Miami-Dade) is overwhelmingly Hispanic. Automated Booksy heuristic leaned 'en' but that counted duplicate review text; qualitative reading of the unique reviews plus the menu evidence supports Spanish as primary. Site is fully bilingual (ES default / EN toggle).
brand_vibe: Warm, feminine boutique nail studio. Minimalist crescent-moon monogram logo in warm taupe/mocha on cream. Photos show soft nude/blush manicures, elegant navy-blue nail art with rhinestones, natural-effect lash extensions, and a friendly, detail-oriented atmosphere (reviews mention coffee service). Site built on the light-v2 skeleton with a new deep plum/mauve palette (accent-deep #6b3f5e, accent-mid #a06a8c) not reused from prior builds.

research_notes: Automated Instagram profile fetch (web_profile_info endpoint and Playwright driver) was blocked (401 rate-limit / net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET) in this sandbox, so IG bio/captions could not be read directly. Business identity, services, prices, reviews, staff names, rating and photos all come from Booksy (the business's own booking platform), which is a stronger primary source per PIPELINE.md. Phone number sourced from a third-party directory (pro.makeup) and corroborated by exact address and staff-name match; treated as reasonably verified but flagged with its source for transparency.
